2. **Catalog completeness 29 points below peer median** — at 61.5% vs. 90% peer median, this is the widest benchmark gap and the most actionable improvement lever for the current period. [→ §peer]
3. **Full feature adoption across all benchmarked capabilities** — all 6 benchmarked features active (feature depth 8/8), placing the account at the top of the comparison group for platform utilization. [→ §peer]
4. **Trajectory 10 points below peer median** — at 70 vs. 80 median (below median), recent platform activity trends trail the comparison group despite strong absolute engagement in the current period. [→ §peer]
